basis: Public question text only; no acquired response, gold label, model identity or correctness used to identify ambiguity.

final_sensitivity.name: exclude_source_ambiguous_options
final_sensitivity.rule: Evaluate the same frozen policies and per-row costs on final rows except these fixed source-ambiguous IDs. Recompute the same aggregate metrics and uncertainty protocol; report both denominators. No refitting, recalibration, threshold selection or answer regeneration.

limitations: A duplicated label can encode two different meanings and identical text can occupy two labels. Upstream label-only references cannot resolve these source defects. Primary scores retain that limitation; the separate sensitivity exposes its final-evaluation effect.
training_ambiguity_policy: Retain disambiguation_qa:018 in the fixed training population with the original source label semantics; do not repair its label or choose an option from model outputs.
